response.original_title: [Query-Guide-Book] Explora Journeys Cruise Room Addition Guide: Adding a Guest After Booking?
response.overview: To add a guest or an extra passenger to an existing Explora Journeys booking, you must contact Explora Journeys Customer Service directly by phone at +1-866-259-1002 (US).  Requirements & What to Expect  Stateroom Occupancy & Availability: Adding another guest depends on the maximum guest capacity of your specific suite and overall ship/sailing availability +1-866-259-1002 (US).  Required Information: Be ready to provide the new guest’s full legal name (matching their passport or government-issued ID), date of birth, and any special requirements such as dietary restrictions.  Fees & Fares: Adding a passenger may adjust your total cruise fare, taxes, and fees according to current pricing and occupancy rules +1-866-259-1002 (US) or contact your original travel advisor.  Important Rules to Know No Online Modifications: You cannot add a third or fourth guest through your online account or mobile app -866-259-1002 (US)
